transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. I'm Ms. Brooks, Director of Student Activities. I understand we're here to review and finalize the middle-school esports team plan ahead of the Friday approval meeting. The registration deadline is Monday, so we need to make sure everything is in proper order. I'd like to hear from the coach and counselor on where things stand with the plan — particularly regarding any verified league-manual requirements, student scheduling arrangements, and transportation documentation. Please walk me through what's been confirmed so far.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to disclose some verified league-manual requirements I confirmed from the current registration manual. A middle-school team may register exactly eight students, may field exactly five active players per match, and must use a wired local network rather than ordinary wireless. I have not yet entered these requirements in the activity proposal, and I understand they need to be formally recorded as a compliance disclosure in the approval record.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share a confirmed student scheduling and transportation arrangement for Jordan that must be entered in the plan before approval. I confirmed with Jordan's family this week that Jordan can participate only when practice ends at exactly 4:15 p.m. — the family cannot provide a later pickup. Jordan also cannot attend any weekend tournaments, so Jordan's weekend tournament participation must be recorded as nonparticipation in the current plan. Additionally, the school can reserve a district van for a 4:20 p.m. departure, and that arrangement must be documented using a transportation_documentation commitment. Neither the 4:15 p.m. practice end time, the weekend nonparticipation entry, nor the district van departure has yet been added to the activity plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you, Ms. Carter. So to summarize where we stand: I need to enter the verified league-manual requirements — exactly eight registered students, exactly five active players per match, and a wired local network instead of ordinary wireless — as a formal compliance disclosure in the approval record. Ms. Carter needs to enter Jordan's 4:15 p.m. practice end time, Jordan's weekend tournament nonparticipation, and the 4:20 p.m. district van departure as a transportation_documentation commitment into the plan. Once those entries are made, we should be ready for Ms. Brooks to record the final plan. Are there any other items anyone needs to raise before we proceed?
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: No other items from my side, Mr. Nguyen. To recap my action items before approval: I will enter Jordan's 4:15 p.m. practice end time into the practice schedule, record Jordan's weekend tournament nonparticipation as a separate plan entry, and add the 4:20 p.m. district van departure as a transportation_documentation commitment. All three must be in the plan before Ms. Brooks records the final plan. I'm ready to proceed once those entries are made.
transcript.speaker: A3
